[[Blind Faith]] |sandbox = No |rewards_increase = +20% }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Enemies gain bloated and nimble.|In-Game Description}} }} ==Description== '''Death''' is one of the curses that appears in the [[Null & Void Event]]. It can be voted for by the players every few waves. If voted for, it will boost enemy stats and rewards. ==Effects== When applied, all enemies will spawn with [[Bloated]] and [[Nimble]], effectively making them four times harder.
